result.summary: Found 1 likely visual defect: a stuck loading spinner overlaying the featured restaurant image. Horizontally clipped carousel items and bottom viewport truncation were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The first 'Popular right now' card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a prominent white circular loading/progress indicator centered over the food image, obscuring the content and suggesting the image or card is stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image resolves or fail gracefully to a static placeholder; hide the spinner after loading completes and avoid placing persistent loaders over key visual content.
